checks.evidence: Replacement saved recovery code issuance triggers notification, steps 1-3: logs in as the representative, requests a replacement code, and receives an account recovery notification.

invented: Notification must contain clear instructions and contact information in case the recipient repudiates the event
Notification is sent to all configured non-postal addresses

Previous recovery code is invalidated upon issuing a replacement
Account must not be locked or suspended
Notification is sent to a postal address when the only other address is the one used for the issued recovery code
